summary: 多份账户相关 EIP 合并为草案：EIP-8397 为 EIP-8141 加入有界的自定义认证器签名，EIP-8357 建立 EVM 验证密钥注册表。lightclient 让 EIP-8141 承诺被省略签名的长度。EF 展示 zkAPI 接入私密推理。Derek Chiang 访谈 L2 后发现，即使不拥堵，L2 也很难把 blob 落上链。

items.topic: Frame 交易的可插拔签名
items.title: 新 EIP：Frame Authenticator Signatures（EIP-8397）
items.note: 合并（leekt）。它是 EIP-8141 的配套 Core EIP，签名格式为 `key_id || proof`，由认证器在状态无关、gas 固定的环境中执行任意密码学，认证出的 key_id 必须等于声明的 key_id，之后照常进入 VERIFY 帧做账户授权。
items.note_en: Was merged (leekt). It is a companion Core EIP to EIP-8141. The signature is `key_id || proof`; the authenticator runs arbitrary cryptography in a state-independent, gas-fixed context, the authenticated key_id must equal the claimed key_id, and the transaction then proceeds to the VERIFY frame for account authorization as usual.

summary_en: Several account-related EIPs were merged as drafts: EIP-8397 adds bounded custom authenticator signatures to EIP-8141, and EIP-8357 sets up an EVM verification key registry. lightclient made EIP-8141 commit to elided signature lengths. The EF showcased zkAPI powering private inference. After interviewing L2s, Derek Chiang found they struggle to land blobs even without congestion.
